layout.body:
Dear All,
The deadline for the science fair project submissions has been extended to March 18th. This gives you five extra days to complete your work. All projects must be submitted to your science teacher by 4:00 PM on the new deadline day.
Best wishes,
John

questions.stem: What is the new submission date?

Where should projects be submitted? 原文依据：All projects must be submitted to your science teacher. 所有项目必须提交给科学老师。 A To science teachers → 正确 B To the main office → 错误 C To the library → 错误 D Online → 错误
